decision: Owner directive 2026-10-19 'Universal Source Voting and Freshness Policy' section 2 (docs/sources/UNIVERSAL_FRESHNESS_SCHEDULE_2026-10-19.md). Supersedes the cadence-relative curve of config/sources/freshness_v1.json for every dynasty ranking source. One owner reads this file: src/sources/freshness.py. Rollback: RISKIT_FEATURE_SOURCE_FRESHNESS_SCHEDULE_V2=0 + restart restores the v1 curve.
description: Voting power as a step function of WHOLE DAYS since the source's last GENUINE publisher update. It multiplies the approved base weight: effective = base x freshness x health x coverage. The clock is a vendor-stated publication time where the source's fetcher records one (data/scrape_state/<key>_upstream.json -> dataset state upstream.publishedAt), never later than the last content change we observed; otherwise the last observed content change (src/sources/dataset_state.py). A successful re-download of unchanged content moves no clock. An update time we cannot establish for a source we are tracking (only the first-observation baseline, a fetch time, is known) is never fresh: it votes at unknownUpdateTimeFreshness (0) and is reported as unknown. A board that predates every observation we hold for a source (a replay older than its tracking), or a source with no recorded state, has no freshness measurement at all and keeps the long-standing unmeasured posture (base weight, clockBasis not_tracked_at_board_time), exactly as a board with no dataset-state directory does.
dayBoundary: days = floor((boardAsOf - clock) / 86400 seconds), measured between two UTC instants, so the result does not depend on any time zone or calendar date. A source updated 7 days 23 hours ago is in day 7 (100%); at exactly 8 x 24 hours it is in day 8 (75%). A clock later than the board's own time counts as day 0.

exemptKeys.ktcCrowdTradesSfTep: KTC Market is the benchmark our model is compared against and never casts a vote, so it is not a dynasty ranking voter; its freshness only qualifies the market comparison and stays on the v1 curve.
